fixes: Raised thresholds avoid coplanar floor faces.
Stable camera near distance with projection-preserving aperture depth clamping.
Expanded aperture bounds keep close portals in CPU culling.
Room-scoped lights and courtyard-only directional daylight.
Shadowed downward spotlights with low unshadowed ceiling fill.
Screen-space AO removed from the PC renderer feature list.
Up to 4x MSAA in the PC pipeline and portal targets.
Overlapping wall partitions seal small edge gaps.

limits: Placeholder materials and final art remain unfinished.

Measurements cover selected portal poses and routes, not every possible camera path.
Verified on this Windows RTX 4080 system; broader hardware and performance testing remains outstanding.
